# Packaging Release Evidence

## Core principle

Assemble a reproducible release dossier linking requirements, build identity, tests, findings, migrations, rollback, and residual risks. Activate only when the typed entry conditions are present; stop rather than inventing a missing tool, decision, or proof.

## When not to use

- an unreleased local experiment
- a release whose source and verification subjects are not frozen
